acceptance.text: Real authenticated transport and executable client/CLI round trips; separate write authority, exact subject/version/idempotency, bounded pagination, approved reproduction dispatch and released M1/M2 compatibility.

Record resource naming, auth matrix, exact identity/idempotency/status/errors, finding versions, reproduction approval, pagination/export integrity and CLI compatibility; synchronize internal draft transport fixtures and scenario mapping without advertising unimplemented public endpoints. One contract owner approves shared fixtures before parallel client/Checks development.

Real HTTP/PostgreSQL/Temporal verifies durable admission, exact authenticated retries, conflicting identities, stale heads/profiles, disabled consumer rejection, cancellation/restart and bounded redacted failures. Publish only working OpenAPI operations and preserve both released compatibility baselines.

Exact-subject finding/history reads, bounded stable pagination and integrity-verifiable complete export work over real HTTP. Wrong scope, invalid cursors and interrupted/truncated exports fail explicitly; M3-C11 export capability is retained.

Operator-authorized mutations enforce expected versions, operation IDs and immutable approved plans with configured consumers. Reject request-supplied commands/images/budgets; verify cancellation before/during staging, termination cleanup and retained receipts; never-staged cancellation stays unverified.

Typed client and executable CLI consume shared fixtures and pass real-server review/finding/reproduction/export round trips after routes are implemented. Verify identity/digests, bounded reads, auth/cancellation/errors/exit codes, no credential logging and preservation of released agentci review behavior. Parallel development does not replace final real transport acceptance.

acceptance.text: Installed agentci review reads only a private strict operator config and existing scoped App/webhook credentials, fetches current open PR identity from GitHub, submits an HMAC-signed request to the existing route with a fresh UUID, validates queued/duplicate response and emits only receipt metadata. Supplied UUID safely repeats ambiguous transport submission without rewriting cancelled evidence. Tests reject unsafe config/permissions/origin, closed/mismatched PRs, redirects, forged/oversized replies, secret leakage and read-only evidence-token scheduling; native controller and real customer acceptance prove a new review without close/reopen. Docs, operation/scenario mapping, packaging and exact-source full CI pass before completion.

Cancelled/unavailable Checks instruct an operator to request a fresh immutable attempt rather than redeliver the failed UUID. When a scoped staged comparison exists, the exact Check exposes authenticated retained comparison evidence and its review/attempt identity without credentials; pre-stage failures remain honest. Native and installed customer verification prove correct links, immutable earlier evidence and unchanged exact-head reconciliation; docs, API/scenario mapping, packaging and exact-source CI pass.

scenarios: private bounded regular credential files and strict config keys
HTTPS or loopback origin with no URL credentials/query/hash/path
GitHub current open PR scope and exact commit identity
fresh UUID for a new cancelled/failed review attempt
same UUID and stable subject for ambiguous transport retry
HMAC authorization distinct from read-only evidence credentials
generic credential-free GitHub and transport failures
native durable outbox and behavioral workflow acceptance
